body:
Last night me and my roommate set out for a trip after extracting 24 grams of freshly dried Cyan's into a 375ml bottle of vodka. We ground up the shrooms in a grinder and let them soak in the vodka for about an hour. After the mixture was put through a coffee filter we were left with about 360ml of very dark blue vodka. We decided that 60ml should be equal to 3 or 4 grams of mushrooms, so we each made a mixed drink with root beer and 60 ml of the elixir.
We drank the first drink quickly and decided to have a few bong hits to help things along. After about 15 minutes we felt some effects but nothing too strong. We kept smoking hash and weed for a while and at the 50 minute mark we decided to take an additional 30 ml each. Which had us quite high in the next 30 minutes but no strong visuals. We decided to smoke some syrian rue extract for a boost and did get a slight increase in visuals along with a strong body buzz.
About 45 minutes later we each consumed another 60ml of the blue elixer followed about 30 minutes later by the rest of it (45 ml more each). So at about 2 or 2.5 hour from initial ingestion we had each taken 180ml of vodka containing the actives from 12 grams of psilocybe cyanescens
at about 2 or 2.5 hour from initial ingestion we had each taken 180ml of vodka containing the actives from 12 grams of psilocybe cyanescens
. We hung out around the apartment for about 45 minutes after that smoking a bunch more weed and hash through my bong and each smoked several hits of the syrian rue extract which gave us a definite boost in both visuals and body buzz. Not long after this we had the idea that we should go for a walk to a nearby park so we could look at the stars and trip. This turned out to be a bad idea. As we walked toward the park out movements became more and more difficult until when we reached the park. I collapsed on the sidewalk and had to drag myself across the grass to sit up against a fence to recover. After about 5 minutes we were able to walk again but not well by any means.
We started to head home hoping we would make it while we could walk. No dice, we got to our apartment building and went in through the underground parking collapsing several times while trying to get across the garage to the elevator. We eventually made it to the elevator and where trying to get our key to call it when a car entered the parkade. Luckily we managed to get into the elevator and push the button for our floor before the person from the car came to share the elevator with us. Sadly our troubles were far from over. When we got to our floor we only made it halfway down the hallway before loosing control of our muscles and lying on the floor helpless. Then a neighbor walked by and we were terrified. After a few minutes I was able to get up and I tried to help my roommate back to the apartment, but before I made it to him my legs got weak and I turned to go back to the apartment but it was too late. I had fallen and once again was paralysed. Using all our strength  to wiggle to the door over the next 15 minutes we got inside after getting jammed in the door on the floor. Once we managed to get inside and close the door we just laid there and waited for our legs to work
we just laid there and waited for our legs to work
. I regained mine after about 5 more minutes and got to a chair in the living room and stayed there. My roommate recovered a short time later. I had never been so glad to be back in my apartment.
We were very high for several hours and sat in the living room smoking some weed until around 5 am when we went to bed and eventually went to sleep. When I woke up it was about 11:30 and I was still somewhat high. I went outside on the deck for a smoke and the clouds danced slightly and everything seemed like it was a little bit more vibrant than normal. Now it is 7:30pm and I am still feeling some mild effects. I feel good though. If I dose that high again I will not leave the house and I will avoid the alcohol in the future as I believe it was the combo which caused the loss of mobility.
